verdict.rationale: mParticle documents several of its own APIs: the Events API with an OpenAPI spec, a Platform API with an Audiences section, the Warehouse Sync API and the versioned Data Subject Request API. Together they cover a meaningful slice of the platform programmatically. But nothing claims or shows UI parity, and some workflows, such as connecting an audience to an output, are documented only as UI navigation. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement or coverage map, documented API equivalents for UI setup tasks (connections, audience outputs, consent filters, data quality plans), machine-readable specs beyond the Events API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the Open API (previously known as Swagger) specification or similar tools to generate helper SDKs (using Swagger Codegen or OpenAPI Generator) for the Events API
with a Warehouse Sync API, SQL reference, and data mapping
Update to the v3 base URL https://opendsr.mparticle.com/v3
